pyqgis_plugin.name: Area Length Buttons
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds Area and Length buttons to the attribute table toolbar. Click to add a virtual field with a chosen unit (m2/km2 or m/km) and decimal precision. Buttons auto enable/disable based on layer geometry type.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds two buttons to every attribute table toolbar. Area button (polygon layers) adds a virtual area field in m2 or km2. Length button (line layers) adds a virtual length field in m or km. Decimal places configurable (default 3). Uses ellipsoidal measurement so geographic (lat/lon) layers also produce correct metric values.
